info.title: pi-agent-server host API
info.description:
Fixed host API contract v1. Dynamic plugin routes are not part of this document.
Request validation semantics: Request bodies use Fastify's AJV baseline: declared types are coerced (`coerceTypes: 'array'`,
so numbers, booleans, and single-element arrays are accepted where a string is declared) and
undeclared fields are silently stripped (`removeAdditional: true` combined with
`additionalProperties: false`) instead of returning 400. A 400 therefore reports a missing
required field or a value that cannot be coerced/constrained, never a wrong scalar type or an
unknown field.

code.description: A model-failback continuation owns this request; retry abort after its end event.

post.description:
The abort body is parsed by a hand-written strict validator, not by AJV: an absent body is
accepted, but a supplied body must contain exactly the `requestId` field with a string value.
Unknown fields and non-string values are rejected with 400 (no type coercion, no silent
stripping).

SessionSystemPrompt.description: Only current effective or creation snapshot provenance is reported. Historical structured records do not prove the forced prompt sent to a model. Empty strings are valid prompts.

visibility.description: Native shared sessions are available to admitted users subject to RBAC and cwd exclusions; absent means private.

id.description: Preserved legacy host message id, if any.

sourceId.description: Pi JSONL message-entry id. When present, exactly matches timeline.messageId; image-only messages have one too.

ExecutionSnapshot.description: Durable host-task loops and real SDK turns, deduplicated across all entries. Partial legacy histories have null totals and recorded-only counts.

costUsdEstimate.description: SDK model-price estimate in USD, not an invoice; zero does not establish free service.

tokensPerSecond.description: SDK output / first nonempty text, thinking or toolcall delta to message_end seconds; null below 10ms. No clamp.

costUsdEstimate.description: SDK model-price estimate in USD, not an invoice; zero does not establish free service.

PromptUsage.description: Every model call of the current host prompt, summed; a field is null once any call lacks it. Null when this process did not run the prompt.

costUsdEstimate.description: SDK model-price estimate in USD, not an invoice; zero does not establish free service.

SubagentUsage.description: Child agent model calls on the current branch (completed assistant messages), summed. Not included in sessionTotals.

costUsdEstimate.description: SDK model-price estimate in USD, not an invoice; zero does not establish free service.

messages.description: Legacy message projection. Pi transcripts include sourceId; no text-based timeline association is permitted.

timeline.description: Current-branch, block-ordered history. Thinking content is preserved verbatim; tool text/JSON is not host-truncated.

CompactionState.description: Ephemeral runtime metadata at lastEventId; absent without an observed live compaction and cleared once the owning task or command ends (completed/error/aborted), so a finished compaction is never replayed. Restore running as unknown until live confirmation. No summary or SDK error.

stopReason.description: Explicitly interrupted assistant text; omitted when unavailable, never inferred from partial text.

text.description: Exact persisted assistant thinking text; no summary substitution.

callId.description: SDK tool-call id; use as the SSE deduplication key.

SteeringInput.description: Legacy text-only or complete correlated identity, optionally with images. File attachments are not supported. Admission is not consumption.

SteeringConsumed.description: Exact queued SDK user-message object was consumed once. Optional message projects its persisted user entry, before subsequent assistant deltas; sourceId deduplicates live/replay/export history. Missing message never implies a visible user bubble. Nonterminal; never acknowledge by matching text.

oneOf.description: The session-steps projection moved, from any source (live events, persisted reconciliation, branch change, idle-time entries). Coalesced to at most one per 250 ms with the final position always sent. Carries no step content: read GET /v1/sessions/{id}/steps; a new projectionId replaces the snapshot. Session-level, never request-owned.

Subagent records or live output moved: a transcript entry (start, message, steer, end), a live partial, or a legacy collected-log tool result. Coalesced to at most one per 250 ms with the final change always sent; also sent while the parent is idle and children run in the background. Carries no run data: read GET /v1/sessions/{id}/subagents. Session-level, never request-owned.

promptTokens.description: Total tokens of this prompt's completed model calls so far.

parentToolCallId.description: Set on calls another tool (such as a codemode script) made.

promptTokens.description: SDK input (excluding cache); null when unavailable, zero when measured.
